title: 第21章 神凰皇朝女皇 凰怜月第22章 师兄你终于来看人家了
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
一场旷世大战。
阴阳圣宗受到的损失主要还是众多弟子死伤。
加上法宝资源的消耗。
虽然赢了。
但是主要也是因为林云力压群雄。
一人以一己之力，把高端战力全部镇压了。
这才导致了一面倒的屠杀。
但是战斗总是要死人的。
尤其是他们人数还不到九大仙宗的一半。
但是好在大战的范围基本都发生在山门之外。
除了外围的一圈宫殿。
内部的核心建筑都保存完好。
不然修缮起来也是一件麻烦事情。
在宗门掌教大殿的最高处。
林云站在一座高塔之上。
整个宗门的情景都映入眼帘。
天空之上是无数的人影在飞来飞去。
各种遁光，仙兽。
所有人在火急火燎的来回飞遁。
现在整个圣宗虽然说不上是百废待兴。

但是也得乱上好几天。
首先是清点战死的师兄弟的尸身和遗物。
然后盘点损失。
加上重建宗门秩序。
这一切都需要庞大的人力物力和时间。
林云身为掌教至尊，倒是有自知之明没有去添乱。
他有他的事情。
出现在人前，反而会影响效率。
身为领袖，他最大的作用是精神支柱和统揽全局。
具体的事情自然有具体的人去做。
但是他的出现依然是让看见他的众弟子都是精神一震。
但是没有人前来打扰。
所有人都在井井有条的忙碌着自己的事情。
林云盘腿坐下。
体内有着一股火热的法力在蠢蠢欲动。
神凰皇朝的来历很古老，传闻中乃是仙凰的血脉遗孤所建立。
每一代都会有一位神女或者神子。
但是最近两代都是凰女。
上一代凰怜月，风华绝代，绝色尤物。
也是如今的女皇。

凰曦儿，如今的神女，长公主，凰女，下一任女皇。
众多尊贵身份于一身。
她们的体内有着仙凰之力。
content_en:
A great battle.
The main losses suffered by the Yin Yang Holy Sect were the deaths and injuries of many disciples.
Plus the consumption of magic weapon resources.
Although he won.
But it was mainly because Lin Yun dominated the crowd.
One person single-handedly suppressed all the high-end combat forces.
This resulted in a one-sided massacre.
But fighting always results in death.
Especially since their number is less than half of the Nine Immortal Sects.
But fortunately, the scope of the war basically took place outside the mountain gate.
Except for a circle of palaces on the outside.
The core buildings inside are well preserved.
Otherwise, repairing it will be troublesome.
At the highest point of the sect headmaster's hall.
Lin Yun stood on a high tower.
The scene of the entire sect came into view.
There are countless figures flying around in the sky.
All kinds of escaping light, fairy beasts.
Everyone was running back and forth in a hurry.
Now, although the entire Holy Sect cannot be said to be in dire straits, it is waiting to be revitalized.
But it would take several days.
The first thing is to count the bodies and relics of the brothers who died in the battle.
Then take stock of the losses.
Plus rebuilding the order of the sect.
All this requires huge manpower, material resources and time.
As the Supreme Headmaster, Lin Yun had the self-awareness not to cause trouble.
He has his own thing.
Appearing in front of others will actually affect efficiency.
As a leader, his greatest role is to provide spiritual support and control the overall situation.
Specific things naturally have specific people to do them.
But his appearance still shocked all the disciples who saw him.
But no one came to bother.
Everyone is busy doing their own things in an orderly manner.
Lin Yun sat down cross-legged.
There is a fiery mana in the body that is ready to move.
The origin of the Divine Phoenix Dynasty is very ancient, and it is rumored that it was founded by the orphans of the Immortal Phoenix bloodline.
Every generation has a goddess or son.
But the last two generations are all Huang girls.
Huang Lianyue of the previous generation was an unparalleled elegance and beauty.
She is also the current queen.
Huang Xi'er, the current goddess, eldest princess, Huang Nu, the next queen.
Many noble identities in one.
They have the power of the Immortal Phoenix within their bodies.
